messages:
sara (oncall): Observed a sudden rampdown of connections at edge-ingress in eu-west at ~10:12 UTC. Customer-facing 502/504s and elevated p95 latency. Filing incident INC-20260322-1. Triage started.

matt (eng-sre): Confirming connection resets from nginx workers, ~30% of frontends reporting repeated upstream connect failures. Rolling circuit-breaker engaged automatically for some routes.

jin (eng-runtime): Pulling logs now. Seeing frequent 'connect() timeout' to lb-backend on a subset of nodes. Suspect a kernel-level socket exhaustion on the ingress hosts.

sara (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) Drain affected ingress nodes, 2) Re-route traffic to eu-west-2 pool, 3) Increase ephemeral port range + sysctl if needed. Executing step 1 now. Status page: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/INC-20260322-1

lia (support): Heads-up — support triage opened. We're proactively messaging customers with impacted connections and a short workaround (retry/backoff). Draft message posted in #support-drafts.

matt (eng-sre): drain command run on ingress-eu-15 and ingress-eu-17. They show decreasing connections. Kicking autoscaler to replace capacity in eu-west-2.

jin (eng-runtime): Quick snippet from host logs: ```May 22 10:13:02 ingress-eu-15 kernel: [tcp] tcp: excessive orphan skbs 512 -> 2048``` Looks like we hit orphan/skb thresholds. Increasing net.ipv4.tcp_max_orphans and net.core.somaxconn on the fly (applied to the live hosts).

sara (oncall): Applied sysctl changes to the affected nodes and reloaded nginx. Early numbers look better. 5xxs trending down but still elevated for long-tail connections.

deploy-bot: Automatic rollback of last ingress kernel patch detected at 10:22 UTC per policy. Action: rollback applied to ingress-eu-16.

matt (eng-sre): Rolling health check: eu-west overall error-rate 5m avg down from 7.2% -> 2.1%. Routing cutover to eu-west-2 holding. Observed a small spike in cold-start latency for a few customers as traffic moved.

oliver (product): Notifying account teams for customers flagged by health checks (top 10 by error-rate). Lia, can you confirm the outbound customer notification schedule?

lia (support): Yep — initial message to impacted customers in 15m, follow-up once fully resolved. Template attached in #support-drafts.

status-bot: Incident INC-20260322-1 | Progress: Mitigation in progress. Impact: Partial outage for some hosted API customers in eu-west. Link: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/INC-20260322-1. Next update in 20 minutes or when status changes.

sara (oncall): Current status: traffic reroute complete, ingress drains finished, kernel knobs applied, autoscaler bringing new healthy capacity. Post-incident action: runbook entry and RCA assignment (owner: matt). Adding follow-up: validate sysctl defaults across fleet and add an automated guard to prevent orphan sk thresholds from being hit again. :white_check_mark:
